list.

## Search the DH UniBe Zotero group {#zotero-search}

The department's shared library holds around 2,500 references. This searches it **live** — it
queries the [Zotero API](https://www.zotero.org/support/dev/web_api/v3/start) from your browser
as you type, so what you see is the library as it is right now. No account or login is needed to
search; you only need [membership](https://www.zotero.org/groups/2386895/dh_unibe/) to add
things.

```{=html}
<div class="zot-search">
  <form class="zot-form" onsubmit="return false;">
    <input type="search" id="zot-q" placeholder="Search by title, author or year — e.g. stochastic parrots, Sahle, OCR"
           autocomplete="off" aria-label="Search the DH UniBe Zotero group library">
    <select id="zot-mode" aria-label="Search scope">
      <option value="titleCreatorYear">Title, author, year</option>
      <option value="everything">Everything (incl. full text)</option>
    </select>
  </form>
  <p class="zot-status" id="zot-status">Type at least three characters to search.</p>
  <ol class="zot-results" id="zot-results"></ol>
  <p class="zot-foot">
    Results come from the public
    <a href="https://www.zotero.org/groups/2386895/dh_unibe/">dh_unibe</a> group library.
    Anyone may read it; members may add to it.
  </p>
</div>

<script>
(function () {
  var GROUP = 2386895, API = "https://api.zotero.org/groups/" + GROUP + "/items/top";
  var q = document.getElementById("zot-q"),
      mode = document.getElementById("zot-mode"),
      status = document.getElementById("zot-status"),
      list = document.getElementById("zot-results");
  var timer = null, seq = 0;

  function el(tag, cls, text) {
    var n = document.createElement(tag);
    if (cls) n.className = cls;
    if (text != null) n.textContent = text;
    return n;
  }

  function link(url, text, cls) {
    var a = el("a", cls, text);
    a.setAttribute("href", url);
    a.setAttribute("target", "_blank");
    a.setAttribute("rel", "noopener");
    return a;
  }

  function render(items, total) {
    list.textContent = "";
    if (!items.length) { status.textContent = "Nothing found. Try fewer or different words."; return; }
    status.textContent = total > items.length
      ? "Showing the first " + items.length + " of " + total + " matches."
      : items.length + (items.length === 1 ? " match." : " matches.");
    items.forEach(function (it) {
      var d = it.data || {}, m = it.meta || {};
      var href = (it.links && it.links.alternate && it.links.alternate.href) || "";
      var doi = d.DOI ? "https://doi.org/" + d.DOI : (d.url || "");
      var venue = d.publicationTitle || d.proceedingsTitle || d.bookTitle || d.publisher || d.repository || "";
      var year = (m.parsedDate || d.date || "").slice(0, 4);

      var li = el("li", "zot-item");
      li.appendChild(href ? link(href, d.title || "(untitled)", "zot-title")
                          : el("span", "zot-title", d.title || "(untitled)"));

      var meta = el("div", "zot-meta");
      if (m.creatorSummary) meta.appendChild(el("span", null, m.creatorSummary));
      if (year) meta.appendChild(el("span", null, year));
      if (d.itemType) meta.appendChild(el("span", "zot-type", d.itemType));
      if (venue) { var v = el("span"); v.appendChild(el("em", null, venue)); meta.appendChild(v); }
      li.appendChild(meta);

      if (doi) {
        var wrap = el("div", "zot-links");
        wrap.appendChild(link(doi, d.DOI ? "doi.org/" + d.DOI : "source"));
        li.appendChild(wrap);
      }
      list.appendChild(li);
    });
  }

  function search() {
    var term = q.value.trim();
    if (term.length < 3) { list.innerHTML = ""; status.textContent = "Type at least three characters to search."; return; }
    var mine = ++seq;
    status.textContent = "Searching…";
    var url = API + "?q=" + encodeURIComponent(term) + "&qmode=" + encodeURIComponent(mode.value) + "&limit=20&format=json";
    fetch(url)
      .then(function (r) {
        if (!r.ok) throw new Error("HTTP " + r.status);
        var t = parseInt(r.headers.get("Total-Results") || "0", 10);
        return r.json().then(function (j) { return { items: j, total: t || j.length }; });
      })
      .then(function (res) { if (mine === seq) render(res.items, res.total); })
      .catch(function () {
        if (mine !== seq) return;
        list.textContent = "";
        status.textContent = "Could not reach the Zotero API. You can search the library directly at ";
        status.appendChild(link("https://www.zotero.org/groups/2386895/dh_unibe/library", "zotero.org"));
      });
  }

  q.addEventListener("input", function () { clearTimeout(timer); timer = setTimeout(search, 350); });
  mode.addEventListener("change", search);
})();
</script>
```

## Contribute

Found something worth adding? Open an
[issue](https://github.com/DHBern/introduction-to-dh/issues/new/choose) or a pull request. Links
suggested by students are credited.
